editorialReview.basis: Exact-model documentation and attributed first-person reports; conservative editorial judgments on the existing 0–10 scale.
editorialReview.calibration: Each value is a provisional judgment, not a numerical result published by a source. Limited observations support the core visual criteria. Text, dialogue and multi-shot scores are low-confidence priors and need targeted outputs. No standard Seedance score, leaderboard rank or vendor speed claim is converted into a Flash score.

sources.title: Dreamina — Seedance 2.5 Flash
sources.observation: Describes 480p/720p iteration, first/end frames, multimodal references and generated audio. Gives product-motion, poster-text and storyboard prompts. Positions standard 2.5 for higher-quality finals.
sources.limits: Prompts and marketing descriptions are not reviewed output evidence. No Flash legibility, phoneme alignment or explicit-cut accuracy measurement was retrieved.

sources.title: Quantslant — Seedance 2.5 Flash: what it does, price and my 720p test
sources.author: Piotr Olszewski
sources.retrieval: Indexed article text; direct page retrieval was unavailable.
sources.observation: Reports three 5-second 720p text-only clips: coffee preparation, cycling and a boat. The author describes clean imagery, intact hands and appropriate ambience, with submission-to-file times of 157, 165 and 180 seconds.
sources.limits: Author-reported observations, not our playback review. Three selected scenes do not establish general reliability, dialogue accuracy, text rendering or MaxVideoAI latency. Retail prices from that service are excluded.

sources.title: SpicyAPI — Seedance 2.5 Flash model tests
sources.retrieval: Indexed model-page text; direct page retrieval was unavailable.
sources.observation: Reports a portrait returning to its source pose, a two-image character/product render and a street edit retaining source audio. A repeated 4-second 480p request took 84 seconds and 4.8 minutes; its broader sample ranged to about 11 minutes.
sources.limits: Selected vendor-reported runs, not an independent controlled set. Provider-specific endpoints, pricing and containers do not establish MaxVideoAI support. Audio retention does not prove speech alignment.

sources.title: BytePlus ModelArk pricing
sources.observation: Flash LIST rates are USD 0.007 per 1,000 tokens without video input and USD 0.0043 with video input. Supplier offers and account discounts are not customer tariffs.

sources.title: MaxVideoAI Seedance tariff preparation
sources.observation: Prepared native admin imports use Flash LIST ×1.6 and standard 2.5 LIST ×2. For 5-second 16:9 text-to-video, prepared Flash customer amounts are USD 0.54 at 480p and USD 1.21 at 720p; standard amounts are USD 1.03 and USD 2.32. These are preparation evidence, not active production quotes.
sources.limits: The value estimate assumes the reviewed tariff candidate is activated. Public price components must still use the current canonical quote and never this dossier.

sources.title: MaxVideoAI exact-model API and output qualification
sources.observation: Eight exact-model outputs completed: the initial 4-second canary documented in the launch dossier and seven adapter canaries covering the five workflows, audio, Auto, first/last frames, mixed and audio-only references, MP4 and MOV. Outputs were decoded and their settings, token usage and hashes recorded.
sources.limits: Technical acceptance and format checks are not a controlled quality benchmark. These samples do not change the eleven editorial scores or establish production median/P90 latency.

fidelity.rationale: Simple scenes and the reported two-reference result support a promising initial adherence estimate; demanding constraints remain untested.

visualQuality.rationale: Reported clean 720p imagery supports this provisional assessment, without claiming flagship detail or reviewed MaxVideoAI renders.

motion.rationale: Reported moving scenes and a return-to-pose example support a cautious estimate; physical stress cases have not been reviewed.

consistency.rationale: Endpoint-pose and reference reports offer limited continuity evidence, without a long-clip identity audit.

anatomy.rationale: The author's hand observation is encouraging but too small a sample to establish human-object reliability.

textRendering.rationale: Provisional editorial prior only. An official text-poster prompt is not a successful legibility test; exact words and stability remain unobserved.

lipsyncQuality.rationale: Audio capability and reported ambience motivate a tentative prior, not a demonstrated lip-sync result. A speaking-face test is still needed.

sequencingQuality.rationale: Storyboard positioning motivates a tentative prior only; explicit shot order, cut transitions and identity across cuts have not been assessed.

controllability.rationale: Documented reference/frame controls and reported editing results support useful control breadth; repeatability remains unmeasured.

speedStability.rationale: Minutes-scale but variable reported delivery warrants caution. No guaranteed speedup, MaxVideoAI median, P90 or failure rate is inferred.

pricing.rationale: The approved markup yields a lower prepared 480p/720p customer price than standard 2.5 for the same simple shot. Value remains subjective and depends on usable output.

publicCopy.en: Provisional editorial estimates from documentation and early external test reports; confidence is limited. No controlled MaxVideoAI quality benchmark yet.
publicCopy.fr: Estimations éditoriales provisoires fondées sur la documentation et de premiers tests externes ; confiance limitée. Aucun benchmark de qualité contrôlé par MaxVideoAI à ce stade.
publicCopy.es: Estimaciones editoriales provisionales basadas en documentación y primeras pruebas externas; confianza limitada. Sin evaluación de calidad controlada de MaxVideoAI por ahora.

limitations: The retrieved sources publish no directly comparable numerical Flash benchmark; all eleven points are MaxVideoAI editorial judgments.
Prompts are not outputs. Reported external observations were not reproduced or independently scored here.
Capability-only priors for text, lip sync and sequencing are not evidence of successful execution or observed failures.
Commercial sources may select favorable outputs. Sample counts, retries and exclusions are incomplete.
Eight owned Flash renders completed on 15 November. They qualify representative API workflows and output handling, not controlled visual quality, text rendering, lip sync or multi-shot accuracy.
Application release validation, reviewed launch media and tariff activation remain release checks; marketing publication settings do not establish them.
MaxVideoAI sells access to these models. Scores must not be presented as an independent laboratory ranking.
nextReview: Run and score the existing quality prompt pack when that separate paid scope is authorized; exact Flash API access is now verified.
Replace weak priors first: product text, speaking-face synchronization and explicit multi-shot continuity.
Reassess value against activated canonical quotes and keep operational latency in its separate production metric.
